prompts.title: AppOps
prompts.description: AppOps (App Operator): one expert skill per desktop or web app, so Claude operates each app the right way - its screens, settings, limits, exports and integrations. Fill in the task and run AppOps in one step.
prompts.content:
# AppOps

Run /appops and help me with the task below. Talk to me in plain words and ask only what you need from me.

* **Task:** `{{task}}`
* **Files:** `{{files}}`
* **Details:** `{{details}}`

If something you need is missing, ask for it in one short message, then continue.

Before you create, change, send, publish, or delete anything, show a short plan and wait for my yes. Read-only checks run without it.

task.label: Task
task.placeholder: Describe what you need in your own words.
task.context: What goes in, what should come out, and any rules it must follow.

files.label: Files
files.context: Where the files for this task are, if there are any.
files.options:
Attached in This Message
In the Claude Project Files
Created Earlier in This Chat
None, Start from Scratch

details.label: Details
details.placeholder: Anything else: deadlines, names, examples, things to avoid.
details.context: Everything the task needs that isn't a file.
